title: 基准饱和后的评估：CORE-Bench案例研究
summary: 当基准准确率饱和后，通常会被淘汰。本文提出应研究六个关键维度：结构效度问题、分布外泛化、效率、可靠性、模型与脚手架的相对重要性、人机协作提升。以CORE-Bench Hard为例，展示了这些维度在准确率饱和后仍能提供有意义见解。
summary_en: When benchmark accuracy saturates, it is often retired. This paper argues for studying six key dimensions: construct validity, out-of-distribution generalizability, efficiency, reliability, model vs. scaffold importance, and human-agent collaboration uplift. Using CORE-Bench Hard, it shows these dimensions yield insights even after accuracy saturation.
